# Android video task fixture

`agent-video-task-android.zip` was generated on 2026-09-24 by compiling and running
the repository's unmodified `VideoTaskBundleIO.java`, using JDK 17 and
`org.json:json:20231013`. It contains invented educational text, no credentials or
user notebook data.

The input arguments were note ID `fixture-note-1`, revision `7`, title
`牛顿第二定律`, Markdown `# 牛顿第二定律\n\n恒力使物体加速：$F=ma$。\n`, audience
`高中生`, learning goal `理解力与加速度的关系`, duration `60`, voice `default`,
speed `1.0`. The exporter generates its own random video task ID. A Bridge
submission has a separate task ID and must preserve the original ZIP request.
